example: Please fasten your seatbelt before the plane takes off.
exampleTranslation: 飞机起飞前请系好安全带。

translation: adj. 牢固的，紧的；严密的 adv. 紧紧地 (形容词/副词，无变形)
example: I have a tight schedule this week, so I can't go to the movies with you.
exampleTranslation: 我这周日程安排很紧，所以不能和你去看电影了。

example: The government decided to tighten the rules on environmental protection.
exampleTranslation: 政府决定收紧环境保护的规定。

translation: v. 扣住，扣紧；(被)压垮 n. 搭扣 (buckle-buckled-buckled)
example: Please buckle your seatbelt; we are encountering some turbulence.
exampleTranslation: 请扣好安全带；我们遇到了气流颠簸。

translation: adj. 不透水的；防水的；严密的 (形容词，无变形)
example: The lawyer presented a watertight argument that left no room for doubt.
exampleTranslation: 律师提出了一个无懈可击的论点，没有留下任何怀疑的余地。

translation: adj. 未固定牢的；自由的 v. 释放；松开 (loose-loosed-loosed)
example: The dog broke loose from its chain and ran into the park.
exampleTranslation: 那只狗挣脱了链子，跑进了公园。

example: He loosened his tie as soon as he got home to relax.
exampleTranslation: 他一回到家就松开领带放松一下。

translation: v. 打开，解开；消除，取消 (undo-undid-undone)
example: It is impossible to undo the damage caused by the mistake.
exampleTranslation: 这个错误造成的损害是无法消除的。

translation: n. 形式；表格 v. 组成；(使)形成 (form-formed-formed)
example: Please fill in this application form and return it to the office.
exampleTranslation: 请填写这张申请表并交回办公室。

translation: adj. 正式的；庄重的；正规的 (形容词，无变形)
example: You should wear formal clothes to attend the job interview.
exampleTranslation: 你应该穿正装去参加求职面试。

translation: n. 正式手续；例行公事 (名词，无变形)
example: There are a few legal formalities that need to be completed before you can start work.
exampleTranslation: 在你开始工作之前，需要完成一些法律手续。

translation: n. 一致；单调；无变化 (名词，无变形)
example: The strict rules ensure the uniformity of the products.
exampleTranslation: 严格的规则确保了产品的一致性。

translation: n. 形成，组成；形成物，组成物 (名词，无变形)
example: The formation of good habits is essential for academic success.
exampleTranslation: 良好习惯的形成对学业成功至关重要。

example: The new government is committed to carrying out economic reforms.
exampleTranslation: 新政府致力于进行经济改革。

translation: n. 改革；改进 (名词，无变形)
example: The reformation of the education system has attracted widespread attention.
exampleTranslation: 教育体制的改革引起了广泛关注。

translation: n. 改良者，改革者 adj. 主张改革的；改良主义的 (名词/形容词，无变形)
example: The reformist proposed a new policy to improve the working environment.
exampleTranslation: 这位改革者提出了一项改善工作环境的新政策。

translation: n. 总体安排；计划；设计 v. 格式化 (format-formatted-formatted)
example: The format of the new quiz show has proved popular among young audiences.
exampleTranslation: 新智力竞赛节目的总体安排已被证明在年轻观众中很受欢迎。

example: All students must conform to the school rules and regulations.
exampleTranslation: 所有学生都必须遵守学校的规章制度。

translation: n. (对社会规则的)遵从，遵守 (名词，无变形)
example: The strict conformity to safety standards prevented any accidents.
exampleTranslation: 对安全标准的严格遵守防止了任何事故的发生。

example: Drivers must comply with the traffic laws to ensure road safety.
exampleTranslation: 司机必须遵守交通法规以确保道路安全。

translation: n. 遵从；服从；顺从 (名词，无变形)
example: The factory was shut down for non-compliance with environmental regulations.
exampleTranslation: 该工厂因不遵守环保法规而被关闭。

translation: v. 确切表达；认真阐述；制定；规划；构想 (formulate-formulated-formulated)
example: The team spent months formulating a detailed plan for the new project.
exampleTranslation: 团队花了几个月时间为新项目制定详细计划。

translation: n. 制定；规划；构想；确切表达 (名词，无变形)
example: The formulation of a new strategy requires careful consideration.
exampleTranslation: 制定新战略需要仔细考虑。

translation: n. 公式；方程式 (名词，无变形)
example: There is no magic formula for success; it requires hard work and persistence.
exampleTranslation: 成功没有神奇的公式；它需要努力和坚持。

translation: n. 计划；程序；节目；项目 v. 预设 (programmed-programmed)
example: The government has launched a new program to help college graduates find jobs.
exampleTranslation: 政府启动了一个帮助大学毕业生找工作的新项目。

translation: v. 做；执行；表演；工作；运转 (perform-performed-performed)
example: It is important to perform well in the interview if you want to get the job.
exampleTranslation: 如果你想得到这份工作，在面试中表现出色是很重要的。

translation: n. 表演；表现；业绩；成绩；执行 (名词，无变形)
example: Her performance in the final exam was excellent, which surprised all her teachers.
exampleTranslation: 她在期末考试中的表现非常出色，这让所有老师都很惊讶。

translation: n. 表演者；演出者 (名词，无变形)
example: The performer received a standing ovation from the audience after the show.
exampleTranslation: 演出结束后，表演者获得了观众的起立鼓掌。

translation: v. 钻(孔)；训练；作...演习 n. 钻头；(应对紧急情况的)演习，训练 (drill-drilled-drilled)
example: The teacher made the students drill the grammar rules until they memorized them.
exampleTranslation: 老师让学生们反复练习语法规则，直到他们记住为止。

translation: v. 通知，告知；了解，熟悉 (inform-informed-informed)
example: Please inform us of any changes in your contact information as soon as possible.
exampleTranslation: 如果您的联系方式有任何变化，请尽快通知我们。

translation: adj. 提供有用信息的；给予知识的 (形容词，无变形)
example: The lecture was not only interesting but also highly informative.
exampleTranslation: 这场讲座不仅有趣，而且信息量很大。

translation: n. 告密者；合作者 (名词，无变形)
example: The police received a tip from a secret informant about the criminal's hideout.
exampleTranslation: 警方从一名秘密线人那里收到了关于罪犯藏身处的线索。

example: You must notify the bank immediately if you lose your credit card.
exampleTranslation: 如果你的信用卡丢失了，你必须立即通知银行。

translation: n. 通知，通告，告示 (名词，无变形)
example: You will receive a notification once your application has been approved.
exampleTranslation: 一旦您的申请获得批准，您将收到通知。

translation: adj. 显著的；显而易见的 (形容词，无变形)
example: There has been a noticeable improvement in her spoken English since she joined the English club.
exampleTranslation: 自从加入英语俱乐部以来，她的英语口语有了显著的提高。

translation: n. 通知；公告牌；注意；警告 v. 注意到，留意 (notice-noticed-noticed)
example: I didn't notice him leaving the room because I was reading.
exampleTranslation: 我没有注意到他离开房间，因为我在看书。

translation: n. 范围；幅度；山脉 v. 变动；排列 (range-ranged-ranged) 【易混淆词：arrange, scope】
example: The hotel offers a wide range of services to meet the needs of different guests.
exampleTranslation: 这家酒店提供广泛的服务，以满足不同客人的需求。(词根：rang (排列) / 构词：range (排列) → 范围；变动)

translation: v. 使有权利；给...命名 (entitle-entitled-entitled) 【易混淆词：title, grant】
example: This ticket entitles you to a free meal in the restaurant.
exampleTranslation: 这张票使你有权在餐厅免费用餐。(词根：titl (标题) / 构词：en- (使) + title (标题) → 使有标题 → 使有权利)

translation: adj. 典型的；有代表性的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：classic, representative】
example: It is typical of him to be late for class.
exampleTranslation: 上课迟到是他的典型作风。(词根：typ (类型) / 构词：type (类型) + -ical (形容词后缀) → 典型的)

translation: n. 社区；社会；团体 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：society, neighborhood】
example: The local community has organized a charity event to help the poor.
exampleTranslation: 当地社区组织了一场慈善活动来帮助穷人。(词根：commun (共同) / 构词：com- (共同) + mun (服务) + -ity (名词后缀) → 社区；团体)

translation: n. 伤害；损害 v. 伤害；损害 (harm-harmed-harmed) 【易混淆词：damage, hurt】
example: Smoking does great harm to your health.
exampleTranslation: 吸烟对你的健康有很大的伤害。(词根：harm (伤害) / 构词：harm (伤害) → 伤害；损害)

translation: n. 项目；工程；计划 v. 投射；放映；预测 (project-projected-projected) 【易混淆词：program, plan】
example: The government has invested heavily in the infrastructure project.
exampleTranslation: 政府在这个基础设施项目上投入了大量资金。(词根：ject (投掷) / 构词：pro- (向前) + ject (投掷) → 向前投掷 → 项目；投射)

translation: n. 地区；区域；范围 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：area, district】
example: This region is famous for its rich natural resources.
exampleTranslation: 这个地区以其丰富的自然资源而闻名。(词根：reg (统治) / 构词：reg (统治) + -ion (名词后缀) → 统治的区域 → 地区)

translation: v. 核实；查证；证实 (verify-verified-verified) 【易混淆词：confirm, certify】
example: The police are trying to verify the identity of the victim.
exampleTranslation: 警方正在努力核实受害者的身份。(词根：ver (真实) / 构词：ver (真实) + -ify (使) → 使真实 → 核实)

translation: n. 效果；影响；作用 v. 产生；实现 (effect-effected-effected) 【易混淆词：affect, impact】
example: The new policy had a positive effect on the local economy.
exampleTranslation: 新政策对当地经济产生了积极的影响。(词根：fect (做) / 构词：ef- (出) + fect (做) → 做出效果 → 效果；影响)

translation: v. 培养；耕作；种植 (cultivate-cultivated-cultivated) 【易混淆词：train, develop】
example: It is important to cultivate good habits from an early age.
exampleTranslation: 从小培养良好的习惯很重要。(词根：cult (耕作) / 构词：cult (耕作) + -ivate (动词后缀) → 培养；耕作)

translation: n. 主管；行政人员 adj. 行政的；执行的 (名词/形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：manager, executor】
example: She is a senior executive in a multinational corporation.
exampleTranslation: 她是一家跨国公司的高级主管。(词根：secut (跟随) / 构词：ex- (出) + secut (跟随) + -ive (形容词后缀) → 跟随执行的 → 行政的)

translation: adj. 在线的；联网的 adv. 在线地 (形容词/副词，无变形) 【易混淆词：offline】
example: More and more people prefer to shop online nowadays.
exampleTranslation: 如今越来越多的人喜欢在网上购物。(词根：line (线) / 构词：on (在...上) + line (线) → 在线的)

translation: v. 下降；衰退；拒绝 n. 下降；衰退 (decline-declined-declined) 【易混淆词：refuse, decrease】
example: The birth rate in this country has been on the decline in recent years.
exampleTranslation: 近年来，这个国家的出生率一直在下降。(词根：clin (倾斜) / 构词：de- (向下) + clin (倾斜) + -e → 向下倾斜 → 下降；衰退)

translation: v. 申请；应用；适用 (apply-applied-applied) 【易混淆词：appeal, request】
example: You need to apply for a visa before traveling to that country.
exampleTranslation: 去那个国家旅行之前，你需要申请签证。(词根：ply (折叠) / 构词：ap- (向) + ply (折叠) → 折叠向 → 申请；应用)

translation: adj. 充足的；适当的；胜任的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：enough, sufficient】
example: Make sure you have adequate time to prepare for the exam.
exampleTranslation: 确保你有充足的时间准备考试。(词根：equ (相等) / 构词：ad- (向) + equ (相等) + -ate (形容词后缀) → 与需求相等 → 充足的)

translation: n. 情况；环境；境遇 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：environment, condition】
example: Under no circumstances should you give up your dreams.
exampleTranslation: 在任何情况下你都不应该放弃你的梦想。(词根：circum (环绕) / 构词：circum (环绕) + st (站立) + -ance (名词后缀) → 环绕站立的状态 → 情况；环境)

translation: v. 成功；继承；接替 (succeed-succeeded-succeeded) 【易混淆词：success, proceed】
example: If you work hard, you will eventually succeed in achieving your goals.
exampleTranslation: 如果你努力工作，你最终会成功实现你的目标。(词根：ced/cess (走) / 构词：suc- (在下面) + ceed (走) → 跟在下面走 → 成功；继承)

translation: n. 步伐；速度 v. 踱步 (pace-paced-paced) 【易混淆词：speed, step】
example: The pace of technological change is accelerating rapidly.
exampleTranslation: 技术变革的步伐正在迅速加快。(词根：pac (和平/步伐) / 构词：pace (步伐) → 步伐；速度)

translation: n. 常规；例行公事 adj. 常规的；例行的 (名词/形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：regular, habit】
example: Getting up at 6 a.m. has become part of my daily routine.
exampleTranslation: 早上6点起床已经成为我日常惯例的一部分。(词根：rout (路线) / 构词：route (路线) + -ine (名词后缀) → 走老路线 → 常规)

translation: n. 框架；结构 v. 构造；陷害 (frame-framed-framed) 【易混淆词：structure, framework】
example: The frame of the building is made of steel, making it very strong.
exampleTranslation: 这座建筑的框架是钢制的，非常坚固。(词根：无 / 构词：frame (框架) → 框架；构造)

translation: prep. 加；外加 adj. 正的；加的 n. 加号 (名词/介词，无变形) 【易混淆词：add, minus】
example: Two plus three equals five, which is a basic math fact.
exampleTranslation: 二加三等于五，这是一个基本的数学事实。(词根：plu (更多) / 构词：plus (更多) → 加)

translation: v. 伸展；延伸；拉紧 n. 一片；一段时间 (stretch-stretched-stretched) 【易混淆词：extend, expand】
example: You should stretch your muscles before doing any intense exercise.
exampleTranslation: 在做任何剧烈运动之前，你应该拉伸肌肉。(词根：stretch (伸展) / 构词：stretch (伸展) → 伸展；延伸)

translation: adj. 充足的；足够的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：adequate, enough】
example: We have sufficient evidence to prove that he is innocent.
exampleTranslation: 我们有足够的证据来证明他的清白。(词根：fic/fac (做) / 构词：suf- (在下面) + fic (做) + -ient (形容词后缀) → 做到 → 充足的)

translation: v. 登记；注册；入学 (enrol-enrolled-enrolled) 【易混淆词：register, sign up】
example: I decided to enrol in a yoga class this semester to keep fit.
exampleTranslation: 我决定这学期报名参加一个瑜伽班来保持健康。(词根：roll (卷) / 构词：en- (使) + rol (卷) → 使卷入名册 → 登记；注册)

translation: n. 最小值；最低限度 adj. 最小的；最低的 (名词/形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：maximum】
example: You need a minimum of five years' experience for this job.
exampleTranslation: 这份工作你至少需要五年的经验。(词根：min (小) / 构词：min (小) + -imum (名词后缀) → 最小值)

translation: v. 组成；构成；创作；使平静 (compose-composed-composed) 【易混淆词：consist, comprise】
example: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.
exampleTranslation: 水是由氢和氧组成的。(词根：pos (放置) / 构词：com- (共同) + pos (放置) → 放置在一起 → 组成)

translation: n. 例外；除外 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：exclusion】
example: Everyone must obey the rules, without exception.
exampleTranslation: 每个人都必须遵守规则，无一例外。(词根：cept (拿) / 构词：ex- (出) + cept (拿) + -ion (名词后缀) → 拿出去 → 例外)

translation: adj. 海外的；国外的 adv. 在海外；在国外 (形容词/副词，无变形) 【易混淆词：abroad, foreign】
example: He is planning to pursue his studies overseas next year.
exampleTranslation: 他正计划明年去海外深造。(词根：over (越过) + sea (海) / 构词：over (越过) + sea (海) + -s → 越过海的 → 海外的)

translation: adj. 安全的；牢固的 v. 保护；获得 (secure-secured-secured) 【易混淆词：safe, obtain】
example: You need to secure your personal information when shopping online.
exampleTranslation: 你在网上购物时需要保护你的个人信息。(词根：cur (关心) / 构词：se- (分开) + cur (关心) → 无需关心 → 安全的)

translation: v. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃 n. 碰撞；坠毁 (crash-crashed-crashed) 【易混淆词：clash, crush】
example: The computer system crashed suddenly, causing a lot of trouble for the office.
exampleTranslation: 电脑系统突然崩溃，给办公室造成了很多麻烦。(词根：无 / 构词：crash (碰撞) → 碰撞；坠毁)

translation: v. 打算；意欲；旨在 (intend-intended-intended) 【易混淆词：mean, plan】
example: I intend to finish the report before Friday so that I can enjoy the weekend.
exampleTranslation: 我打算在星期五之前完成这份报告，这样我就可以享受周末了。(词根：tend (伸展) / 构词：in- (向) + tend (伸展) → 向...伸展 → 打算)

translation: n. 特征；特性 adj. 典型的；特有的 (名词/形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：feature, trait】
example: Patience is a characteristic of a good teacher.
exampleTranslation: 耐心是一位好老师的特征。(词根：character (特征) / 构词：character (特征) + -istic (形容词/名词后缀) → 特征)

translation: v. 定义；界定；阐明 (define-defined-defined) 【易混淆词：explain, describe】
example: It is difficult to define the word "happiness" because it means differently to everyone.
exampleTranslation: 很难给“幸福”这个词下定义，因为它对每个人的意义都不同。(词根：fin (界限) / 构词：de- (加强) + fin (界限) + -e → 划定界限 → 定义)

translation: v. 承认；致谢；确认收到 (acknowledge-acknowledged-acknowledged) 【易混淆词：admit, recognize】
example: She acknowledged that she had made a mistake in the calculation.
exampleTranslation: 她承认自己在计算中犯了一个错误。(词根：knowledge (知识) / 构词：ac- (加强) + knowledge (知识) → 承认知道 → 承认)

translation: v. 说明；举例说明；给...作插图 (illustrate-illustrated-illustrated) 【易混淆词：explain, demonstrate】
example: The teacher illustrated his point with a vivid example from daily life.
exampleTranslation: 老师用日常生活中的一个生动例子说明了他的观点。(词根：lustr (光) / 构词：il- (加强) + lustr (光) + -ate (动词后缀) → 使发光 → 说明)

translation: n. & v. 辩论；争论 (debate-debated-debated) 【易混淆词：argue, discuss】
example: There is a heated debate about whether students should use mobile phones in class.
exampleTranslation: 关于学生是否应该在课堂上使用手机存在着激烈的争论。(词根：bat (打击) / 构词：de- (向下/加强) + bat (打击) + -e → 互相打击 → 辩论)

translation: n. 过程；进程 v. 处理；加工 (process-processed-processed) 【易混淆词：procedure, progress】
example: Learning a new language is a long and gradual process.
exampleTranslation: 学习一门新语言是一个漫长而渐进的过程。(词根：cess (走) / 构词：pro- (向前) + cess (走) → 向前走 → 过程)

translation: n. 压力；强调 v. 强调；重读 (stress-stressed-stressed) 【易混淆词：pressure, emphasize】
example: He is suffering from great stress because of the heavy workload.
exampleTranslation: 由于繁重的工作量，他承受着巨大的压力。(词根：strict/string (拉紧) / 构词：stress (拉紧) → 压力；强调)

translation: adj. 无辜的；无罪的；天真的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：naive, blameless】
example: The court found him innocent of the crime after a thorough investigation.
exampleTranslation: 经过彻底调查，法庭判定他无罪。(词根：noc (伤害) / 构词：in- (不) + noc (伤害) + -ent (形容词后缀) → 不伤害的 → 无辜的)

translation: v. 装饰；布置 (decorate-decorated-decorated) 【易混淆词：furnish, adorn】
example: We are going to decorate the classroom for the New Year party.
exampleTranslation: 我们要为了新年晚会装饰教室。(词根：decor (装饰) / 构词：decor (装饰) + -ate (动词后缀) → 装饰)
